faq_heading: Ranch Park houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Ranch Park. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Ranch Park, Coquitlam: 17 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 4 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 24%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 6 of 23 Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Ranch Park fell from 41 in June to 17 in October (−58.5%), and 13 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 4.5% of Coquitlam’s 378 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Ranch Park?
Ranch Park also had 2 condos and townhomes listed and 1 sold in October, against 17 houses listed.

blocks.text: Ranch Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

32 houses sold in Ranch Park with a median price of $1,485,000 (the middle half sold between $1,384,625 and $1,796,000), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 95.6% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $579 per square foot, a median year built of 1973 and a median lot of 8,911 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Ranch Park?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 17 houses listed in Ranch Park. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Ranch Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Ranch Park had a sales ratio of 24%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Ranch Park from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 13 houses sold in Ranch Park over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Ranch Park?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Ranch Park sell for?
faq.a: 32 houses sold in Ranch Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,485,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Ranch Park?
faq.a: The median was 24 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.6% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
